meta.signal_semantics: Keyword evidence indexed in this repository. Counts are records with at least one matching countermeasure term; they are not obligation values, program budgets, deployed inventory, or proof of operational coverage.
meta.caveat: Hand-seeded TTP catalog and boundary-aware keyword search against a public procurement, funding, and parts corpus. Absence of a match is not absence of capability or spending: programs may be classified, described with different terminology, or absent from the indexed sources. Treat high scores as research triage, then verify against official solicitations, awards, budgets, doctrine, and program records.
